Results:

- 52/52 items classified: 4 exact-source, 39 semantic-source, 7 trivial, and 2 page-specific AI-generated compositions.
- Proof provenance: 20 `ai-altered`, 24 `ai-generated`, 4 `not-applicable`, 4 `not-supplied`.
- Classical results were checked against sources including [May’s topology notes](https://math.uchicago.edu/~may/FINITE/REUNotes2010/Topology10.pdf), the [Encyclopedia of Mathematics](https://encyclopediaofmath.org/wiki/Sorgenfrey_topology), [Urysohn’s lemma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urysohn%27s_lemma), and the [Tietze extension theorem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tietze_extension_theorem).

Findings requiring A3 adjudication:

- One false mathematical claim in the choice-cost Remark: it incorrectly lists the perfect-normality zero-set theorem as spending no choice beyond inherited Urysohn DC, although that theorem applies DC again at step 5.1.
- Four citation-precision proposals affecting five items:
  - missing interval-basis source in the finite-minimum lemma;
  - missing usual-topology source for the half-interval facts in Urysohn and Tietze;
  - indirect Facts-section citation for the metric distance-to-set criterion;
  - malformed inline `[L2]` in the Sierpiński example.

Coverage is complete: all 44 proof-bearing items, 266 numbered steps, 237 distinct fact-to-target citations, and 352 boundary dispositions were read. The strict contract check has only the expected malformed-`L2` error; no other contract error was reported.
